odd_moments.proof: Pi_tr^R is even: Pi_tr^R(-z)=Pi_tr^R(z) as a distribution (u_mu^R even; K has even order and constant coefficients). The bump w is even. For odd multiindex γ, φ_γ=w z^γ/γ! is odd. Pairing of an even distribution with an odd compact test vanishes. Hence M_γ=0 for |γ| odd.

moment_formulae.M_gamma: M_{gamma; mu nu rho sigma} = ⟨Pi_tr^R, w z^gamma/gamma!⟩

formal_transpose.statement: K is a constant-coefficient PDO of even order. Moving K from Pi_tr=(iκ²/4) K u onto the test uses the formal transpose K^T of the distributional pairing ⟨K u, φ⟩ = ⟨u, K^T φ⟩. For even-order const-coeff operators with real coefficients, K^T = K on compactly supported smooth tests. XVI-K coherence: this is NOT an arbitrary integration-by-parts identity, and NOT an L2 adjoint unless a sesquilinear form is actually defined.

L.definition: L_{mu nu rho sigma} = sum_{|gamma|<=4} (-1)^{|gamma|} M_{gamma; mu nu rho sigma} partial^gamma delta
L.sign_convention: Matches XVI-K lem:defect pairing c_{alpha,gamma}=(-1)^{|gamma|} ⟨q^R, partial_alpha w_gamma⟩ adapted to order ≤4

locality.reason: Pi_tr and Pi_w agree on U; sd≤8 ⇒ difference is origin-supported of order ≤4 (XIII-C floor(s-4); XVI-K). Differentiation may raise the defect order by one ⇒ ∂L bound five.

L.why_not_claimed: A non-Lorentz-invariant bump does not, by itself, prove that every resulting contact difference L is noncovariant. Covariance of Pi_tr^R need not pass to L; this release records Lorentz covariance of L as not_claimed / not_established (XIII-C separates partial-collision contact from total diagonal).

Pi_w_plus_L_eq_Pi_tr.proof: ⟨Pi_w, f⟩ = ⟨Pi_tr, W_w f⟩ = ⟨Pi_tr, f⟩ - ⟨Pi_tr, w J_4 f⟩. ⟨Pi_tr, w J_4 f⟩ = sum_γ ∂^γ f(0) M_γ. ⟨L, f⟩ = sum_γ M_γ ∂^γ f(0) because ⟨(-1)^{|γ|} M_γ ∂^γ δ, f⟩ = M_γ ∂^γ f(0). Hence ⟨Pi_tr - Pi_w, f⟩ = ⟨L, f⟩.
